text.content:
Colonel Hansen's private army in Dogtown.

Turf: Dogtown, Pacifica
Leadership: Colonel Kurt Hansen
Known for: Enforcing Hansen's word as law

When Kurt Hansen took Dogtown at the end of the Unification War, the rest of his NUSA unit became BARGHEST, topped up with recruits from the locals. Hansen gives his troops weapons, training, pay and medical care, and expects total loyalty in return.

Break their rules in Dogtown and, at best, you're thrown out. At worst your parts end up for sale in the market.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.25
